name: Notes of a Snow Flower
source:
In a small port city a girl, Mayl and her friends do their best to make a living. In midst of her daily routines she discovers romantic feelings in a place she was not expecting.

[From [url=https://wintervale.itch.io/notes-of-a-snow-flower]itch.io[/url]]
